name: R2 Coat of arms double ring

system.description:
[Trigger: Action] Use at the same time as your [Magic attack] with "Range: 2Sq" or more. The range of that attack is +1Sq. Can be used once per scene.

A ring shaped like two rings intertwined and connected. Its shape itself depicts a crest that amplifies magical power.

Bond Medal [Core Material] (30G) + Ash Ring (70G) x 2 + [Magic Catalyst 2] (20G) x 2 + Crafting Cost (70G)
